info.name: Oracle Cloud My Services Cloud Accounts Resource API
Returns a Cloud Account resource collection, default ordering is "id:asc".

params.name: domain
params.description: The identity domain name or the IDCS GUID of the resource

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of resources to return

params.name: name
params.description: Filter on the cloud account name

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting offset of the resources to return

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Ordering of the resources, this resource can be ordered by id, modifiedOn, createdOn

items.docs: Returns a Cloud Account resource collection, default ordering is "id:asc"
